count_note: JPL SSD discovery page header reads "Satellites of Saturn: 293" and its table includes MPEC announcements through 2026-G75 (S/2023 S63). NASA science.nasa.gov (Aug 2026) and NASA APOD 2026-08-11 both state 293 confirmed moons as of June 2026 — the 293 count is VERIFIED against independent sources. Trajectory: 146 (2023) -> 274 (March 2025, +128 announced) -> 293 (2026, +19 from the 2025-E153/E154/E155 and 2026-F14/G68-G75 MPEC batches). Composition: 67 numbered (Roman I-LXVII; 63 named, 4 numbered-but-unnamed: S/2004 S26, S/2004 S29, S/2004 S34, S/2004 S7) + 226 provisional-only = 293 total. Note: JPL page footer says "last updated 2023-May-23" but the table itself carries 2025/2026 MPEC rows — the footer text is stale, the data is current.
